war.match: Match each battle or campaign to the war it belonged to.

war.all: Which {n} of these were part of {value}?

rows.label: Battle of Stalingrad
rows.description: 1942 major battle of World War II
rows.hook: became a brutal street-by-street clash in a city on the Volga that turned the tide against the Nazis

rows.label: Operation Barbarossa
rows.description: invasion of the Soviet Union by the Nazi German-led Axis powers in Europe
rows.hook: was Hitler's massive surprise attack on his one-time pact partner, launched in the summer

rows.label: Battle of Thermopylae
rows.description: battle of 480 BCE during Persian invasion of Greece
rows.hook: saw 300 Spartans and their allies hold a narrow coastal pass against a vast invading army

rows.label: Battle of the Little Bighorn
rows.description: June 1876 battle of the Great Sioux War
rows.hook: is remembered as Custer's Last Stand, where a cavalry commander and his men were wiped out

rows.label: Battle of Gettysburg
rows.description: 1863 battle of the American Civil War
rows.hook: was a three-day Pennsylvania clash that ended with Pickett's Charge and a turning point for the Union

rows.label: 1939 Invasion of Poland
rows.description: German, Soviet, and Slovak attack on and takeover of Poland that marked the start of World War II
rows.hook: began with German tanks crossing the border, prompting Britain and France to declare a global conflict

rows.label: Battle of the Alamo
rows.description: 1836 major battle of the Texas Revolution
rows.hook: ended with the defenders of an old San Antonio mission killed, inspiring the cry to remember it

rows.label: Battle of Antietam
rows.description: 1862 major battle of the American Civil War
rows.hook: is the bloodiest single day in US military history, fought along a Maryland creek

rows.label: Battle of Okinawa
rows.description: 1945 major battle of the Pacific War
rows.hook: was the last and largest island assault of the Pacific, fought with kamikaze attacks offshore

rows.label: Battle of Agincourt
rows.description: 1415 English victory in the Hundred Years' War
rows.hook: saw English longbowmen cut down a much larger French force of armored knights in thick mud

rows.label: Battle of Berlin
rows.description: 1945 last major offensive of the European theatre of World War Il
rows.hook: ended with the Soviet army storming the German capital as Hitler took his own life in a bunker

rows.label: Battle of Britain
rows.description: air battle waged between German and British air forces in 1940
rows.hook: was fought in the skies, where Spitfires and Hurricanes held off the Luftwaffe to prevent an invasion

rows.label: Battle of Verdun
rows.description: 1916 battle on the Western Front during the First World War
rows.hook: was a nearly year-long grinder of trench fighting, symbolising French determination and mass slaughter

rows.label: Tet Offensive
rows.description: 1968 military campaign during the Vietnam War
rows.hook: was a surprise wave of attacks launched during a lunar new year truce, shaking American public opinion

rows.label: Peninsular War
rows.description: 1807–1814 conflict during the Napoleonic Wars
rows.hook: was fought across Spain and Portugal, where Wellington and local guerrillas wore down Napoleon's army

rows.label: Battle of Cannae
rows.description: major battle of the Second Punic War (216 BCE)
rows.hook: saw Hannibal's double envelopment destroy a far larger Roman army, a textbook tactical masterpiece

rows.label: Siege of Leningrad
rows.description: 8 September 1941 – 27 January 1944 blockade of Leningrad by the Axis
rows.hook: was a blockade lasting roughly 900 days in which hundreds of thousands starved in a frozen city

rows.label: Siege of Yorktown
rows.description: siege, part of American Revolutionary War
rows.hook: ended with Cornwallis surrendering to Washington and his French allies, effectively ending the colonial fight

rows.label: French invasion of Russia
rows.description: 1812 conflict during the Napoleonic Wars
rows.hook: saw Napoleon's Grande Armée march to Moscow and then freeze and starve on the long retreat

rows.label: Battle of Leyte Gulf
rows.description: 1944 the largest naval battle of World War II
rows.hook: is considered the largest naval clash in history, fought near the Philippines with carriers and battleships

rows.label: Battle of Rorke's Drift
rows.description: battle in the Anglo-Zulu War, specifically the defence of the mission station of Rorke's Drift
rows.hook: saw about 150 British soldiers hold a mission station against thousands of warriors, as in a famous film

rows.label: Fall of Saigon
rows.description: 1975 capture of Saigon by the People’s Army of Vietnam and the National Liberation Front of South Vietnam
rows.hook: was marked by helicopters lifting people off a rooftop as the American-backed southern capital collapsed

rows.label: Battles of Lexington and Concord
rows.description: first military engagements of the American Revolutionary War (1775)
rows.hook: opened the fight for independence with the famous shot heard round the world

rows.label: Battle of the Boyne
rows.description: 1690 battle
rows.hook: saw two rival kings, William of Orange and James II, meet on an Irish river, a day still marked by parades

rows.label: Battle of Jutland
rows.description: 1916 naval battle during World War I
rows.hook: was the largest clash of battleships in the Great War, between two rival fleets off Denmark

rows.label: Battle of Borodino
rows.description: 1812 battle during the French invasion of Russia
rows.hook: was the bloodiest day of Napoleon's march on Moscow, later the setting of Tolstoy's War and Peace

rows.label: Operation Bagration
rows.description: 1944 large Soviet military offensive in WW2
rows.hook: was a huge Soviet summer push that destroyed German Army Group Centre in Belarus

rows.label: Battle of Bunker Hill
rows.description: 1775 early battle of the American Revoluntionary War
rows.hook: is famed for the order not to fire until you see the whites of their eyes

rows.label: Battle of Marathon
rows.description: 490 BCE battle in the Greco-Persian wars
rows.hook: saw outnumbered Athenians beat an invading empire, inspiring the legend of a runner and a long race

rows.label: Battle of Dien Bien Phu
rows.description: The decisive battle of the First Indochina War
rows.hook: ended with a French garrison in a mountain valley surrendering to Viet Minh forces, ending colonial rule

rows.label: Operation Torch
rows.description: 1942 Allied landing operations in French North Africa during World War II
rows.hook: was the Allied landing on the Moroccan and Algerian coasts, a first big amphibious assault

rows.label: Battle of Sedan
rows.description: 1870 battle during the Franco-Prussian War
rows.hook: saw the French emperor Napoleon III surrender with his army, leading to the fall of his empire

rows.label: Battle of Bosworth Field
rows.description: 1485 last significant battle of the Wars of the Roses
rows.hook: ended with Richard III killed and the crown taken by Henry Tudor, founding a new dynasty

rows.label: Battle of Moscow
rows.description: 1941 World War II campaign in Russia
rows.hook: was the Germans' drive toward the Soviet capital, halted in winter snow within sight of the city

rows.label: Allied invasion of Sicily
rows.description: 1943 military campaign of World War II on the island of Sicily, Italy
rows.hook: was a landing on a Mediterranean island that toppled Mussolini, led by Patton and Montgomery

rows.label: Battles of Saratoga
rows.description: 1777 major turning point of the American Revolutionary War
rows.hook: saw a British general surrender his whole army to the rebels, convincing France to join their side

rows.label: Third Battle of Ypres
rows.description: Battle in the First World War
rows.hook: is better known as Passchendaele, a war of mud and rain in Flanders with enormous casualties

rows.label: Battle of Bannockburn
rows.description: 1314 battle during the First War of Scottish Independence
rows.hook: saw Robert the Bruce's Scots rout a larger English army led by Edward II

rows.label: Battle of Dunkirk
rows.description: 1940 battle in the Second World War between the Allies and Germany
rows.hook: was the desperate evacuation of the stranded British army by fleets of small civilian boats

rows.label: Battle of the Atlantic
rows.description: 1939 longest continuous military campaign in World War II
rows.hook: was the long struggle between U-boats and convoy escorts to keep supply lines open to Britain

rows.label: Battle of Salamis
rows.description: 480 BCE naval battle fought between an alliance of Greek city-states and the Persian Empire
rows.hook: saw a clever Greek fleet trap a larger navy in a narrow strait, led by Themistocles

rows.label: Battle of Gaugamela
rows.description: decisive battle of Alexander the Great's invasion of the Persian Achaemenid Empire
rows.hook: was the clash where a Macedonian king routed the much larger army of Darius III

rows.label: Battle of Crécy
rows.description: 1346 battle of the Hundred Years' War
rows.hook: was an early triumph for English and Welsh longbowmen over French knights under King Edward III

rows.label: Italian Campaign
rows.description: 1943–1945 military campaign of World War II
rows.hook: was the slow grind up a mountainous peninsula, featuring Monte Cassino and the landing at Anzio

rows.label: Battle of Zama
rows.description: final battle of the Second Punic War
rows.hook: was where Scipio Africanus finally defeated Hannibal near Carthage, ending Rome's greatest threat

rows.label: Battle of Poitiers
rows.description: 1356 battle of the Hundred Years' War
rows.hook: saw the English capture the French king John II with a small army of archers

rows.label: Battle of Alesia
rows.description: decisive Roman victory in which Rome secures the conquest of Gaul
rows.hook: saw Julius Caesar trap the chieftain Vercingetorix inside a hilltop fortress with double siege walls

rows.label: Battle of Singapore
rows.description: 1942 World War II battle
rows.hook: saw the Japanese force the largest British surrender in history, taking the so-called Gibraltar of the East

rows.label: Battle of Tarawa
rows.description: battle in the Pacific Theater of World War II, at the Tarawa Atoll in the Gilbert Islands
rows.hook: was a costly Marine assault across a coral reef, where landing craft got stuck on the shallows

rows.label: Battle of Fort Sumter
rows.description: bombardment of Fort Sumter, immediate cause and first battle of the American Civil War
rows.hook: began when Confederate guns shelled a harbour garrison, opening hostilities between North and South

rows.label: Battle of Chancellorsville
rows.description: 1863 major battle of the American Civil War
rows.hook: is called Robert E. Lee's greatest victory, though it cost him his general Stonewall Jackson

rows.label: Battle of Stirling Bridge
rows.description: 1297 battle of the First War of Scottish Independence
rows.hook: saw William Wallace and Andrew Murray defeat the English as they tried to cross a narrow crossing on the Forth

rows.label: Case Blue
rows.description: German summer offensive of 1942 in southern Russia
rows.hook: was the Germans' drive toward the Caucasus oil fields and the Volga, which ended in disaster

rows.label: Battle of Tannenberg
rows.description: 1914 battle between Russia and Germany
rows.hook: was a German victory in East Prussia that destroyed a Russian army and made Hindenburg a hero

rows.label: Battle of Balaclava
rows.description: 1854 battle of the Crimean War
rows.hook: included the doomed cavalry attack known as the Charge of the Light Brigade and the Thin Red Line

rows.label: Battle of Adwa
rows.description: battle between the Ethiopian Empire and the Kingdom of Italy near the town of Adwa, the climactic battle of the First Italo-Ethiopian War, securing Ethiopian sovereignty
rows.hook: was a stunning African victory over a European colonial army, keeping one nation independent

rows.label: Battle of San Jacinto
rows.description: 1836 decisive battle of the Texas Revolution
rows.hook: lasted about eighteen minutes, with Sam Houston's force routing the Mexican army and capturing Santa Anna

rows.label: Battle of Issus
rows.description: second great battle of Alexander's conquest of Asia
rows.hook: saw a young Macedonian king defeat Darius III, who fled the field, leaving behind his family
